Hi Jurgen,

I have a small problem. I could successfully run the up to mapdetection command without any individual species suggested it was alright. Command is below

Mapstest2 <- detectionMaps(CTtable = camtraps, recordTable = sppRT, Xcol = "utm_x", 
                                                     Ycol = "utm_y", stationCol = "Station", speciesCol = "Species",
                                                     printLabels   = TRUE,
                                                       richnessPlot  = FALSE, speciesPlots  = TRUE,      
                                                       addLegend     = TRUE, smallPoints = 3
)
I also got the plot which is attached but when I try to run the same command with individual species names I get the error 'Error: species Leopard Cat not found in speciesCol of recordTable'. Interesting thing is I ran this command before and got the detection maps for individual species. Here's my command

Mapstest2 <- detectionMaps(CTtable = camtraps, recordTable = sppRT, Xcol = "utm_x", 
                                                     Ycol = "utm_y", stationCol = "Station", speciesCol = "Species",
                                                      speciesToShow = "Leopard Cat", printLabels   = TRUE,
                                                       richnessPlot  = FALSE, speciesPlots  = TRUE,      
                                                       addLegend     = TRUE, smallPoints = 3
)

Looking forward to your help.

Thank you in advance.

Best,

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: species not found in speciescol of recordtable
parts:
Hi Yadav, 
please check:
"Leopard Cat" %in% unique(sppRT$Species)

and if it returns FALSE, check
unique(sppRT$Species)

to see if there are any accidental spaces in the Leopard Cat entry, e.g. "Leopard Cat "

If that doesn't help, please share a tiny subset of your camera trap table and record table to reproduce the problem (2 stations and 1 record should be enough). 
Thank you,
Jürgen
